description: The Quality Assurance and Quality Control Director approves new or improved processes and systems to ensure that quality standards in biopharmaceuticals manufacturing plants are upheld. He/She holds overall responsibility for the Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA&QC) departments activities within the organisation. He is responsible for all major decisions regarding the validation of manufacturing processes, product registration, release and recall, as well as internal and external audit policies.
